stories.title: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久 / Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say

sources.title: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久 / Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.title_zh: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久
sources.title_en: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.title_original: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章用272个真实SFT任务对比：FLOP估算仅R²=0.31、MAE 12.41 h，仅用调度前信息的CatBoost达R²=0.98、MAE 1.71 h，解释微调为何常超FLOPs预期。

en.reason: Across 272 production SFT runs, FLOP-based estimates reached only R²=0.31 and 12.41 h MAE, while CatBoost using pre-scheduling information hit R²=0.98 and 1.71 h MAE, explaining why fine-tuning often outruns FLOP predictions.

stories.title: The Silent Consensus

sources.title: The Silent Consensus
sources.title_en: The Silent Consensus

en.title: Musk publicly calls out Altman, saying SpaceX will never sell compute to OpenAI
en.reason: Elon Musk said on X that SpaceX sells zero compute to OpenAI, rebutting Sam Altman's claim that chipmakers overestimate demand and double-count orders and arguing that slow OpenAI demand growth would signal a product problem.

sources.summary:
Google Deeepmind's Gemini 4 Neon offers 1M context at $3/$15 per million tokens and tops AA’s Coding Agent Index.
Google Deeepmind's Gemini 4 Neon offers 1M context at $3/$15 per million tokens and tops AA’s Coding Agent Index.
Google DeepMind just released Gemini 4 Neon . Gemini 4 Neon is a reasoning model that sits between Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Hydrogen. It targets coding agents, knowledge work and science workflows. The developer pitch is near-frontier scores at a lower cost per task.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon，支持 1M 上下文，定价每百万 token 输入 3 美元、输出 15 美元，主打编程 agent 与知识工作；它在 Vals Index 得 70.9% 排第二，但 Terminal-bench 4.1 以 65.2% 略输 Claude Opus 5.5 的 65.8%。

en.reason: Gemini 4 Neon pairs a 1M-token context window with $3/$15 per million input/output tokens, targets coding agents and knowledge work, and tops the AA Coding Agent Index.

sources.title: Pangram 判定一本获奖秘鲁小说 99% 的内容由 AI 生成，但出版社仍力挺自家作者 / Pangram flags 99 percent of an award-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but the publisher stands by its author
sources.title_zh: Pangram 判定一本获奖秘鲁小说 99% 的内容由 AI 生成，但出版社仍力挺自家作者
sources.title_en: Pangram flags 99 percent of an award-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but the publisher stands by its author
sources.title_original: Pangram flags 99 percent of an award-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but the publisher stands by its author
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Pangram将秘鲁作家David Silva Rojas的获奖小说99%判为AI生成，墨西哥出版商Almadía审查作者文件后仍维持奖项，且Pangram还把其80%以上个人文本标为机器写作，法国Gallimard计划明年用它筛查手稿。

en.reason: Pangram flagged 99 percent of Peruvian author David Silva Rojas's prize-winning novel as AI-generated, yet Mexican publisher Almadía upheld the award after reviewing his files, while over 80 percent of his personal texts were also marked machine-written and France's Gallimard plans to screen manuscripts with the tool next year.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 开源框架Artex以Go编写、7月由Autumn-27发布在GitHub，自8月底起被用于针对全球公司、政府机构和银行的AI渗透攻击，让新手靠自然语言提示在数小时内完成原本需数天的入侵。

en.reason: Artex, an open-source Go framework released by Autumn-27 on GitHub in July, has been used since late August in AI attacks on companies, government agencies and banks, letting novices run intrusions in hours via natural-language prompts that once took days.

en.title: 2026 Outlook: AI apps are getting harder to build—so where can ordinary people still make money?
en.summary: Funding for AI app startups is tightening, leaving many indie developers and founders unsure where to focus. This piece skips the crowded foundational infrastructure race and lays out two practical directions for ordinary people. Rather than chasing the latest tech hype, start with real consumer pain points close to home — and even non-experts can find an AI business opportunity that fits them.

sources.summary: 这篇文章拆解了一个有意思的行业反转：曾经热度拉满的AI浏览器逐步退潮，古老的TTY终端反而在AI编程Agent场景重回主流。文中梳理了SSH、Mosh、Web-PTY、tmux等方案的优劣边界，给出了清晰的自研红线，同时还给出了配套的隔离方案、密钥治理、移动端远程接管的选型思路，或许可以帮你少走弯路。

en.title: AI Browsers Lose Steam, TTY Makes a Comeback: From Remote Connections and Technical Choices to Infrastructure Evolution in the Agent Era
en.summary: This piece unpacks a curious industry reversal: AI browsers, once hyped to the max, are ebbing, while the age-old TTY terminal is back in the mainstream for AI coding Agent work. It walks through where SSH, Mosh, Web-PTY, tmux and similar options each shine and where they break down, draws clear red lines for building your own, and lays out supporting choices around isolation, key governance, and mobile remote takeover—which may help you avoid a few wrong turns.

primary_item.summary: 这篇文章拆解了一个有意思的行业反转：曾经热度拉满的AI浏览器逐步退潮，古老的TTY终端反而在AI编程Agent场景重回主流。文中梳理了SSH、Mosh、Web-PTY、tmux等方案的优劣边界，给出了清晰的自研红线，同时还给出了配套的隔离方案、密钥治理、移动端远程接管的选型思路，或许可以帮你少走弯路。

en.title: AI Browsers Lose Steam, TTY Makes a Comeback: From Remote Connections and Technical Choices to Infrastructure Evolution in the Agent Era
en.summary: This piece unpacks a curious industry reversal: AI browsers, once hyped to the max, are ebbing, while the age-old TTY terminal is back in the mainstream for AI coding Agent work. It walks through where SSH, Mosh, Web-PTY, tmux and similar options each shine and where they break down, draws clear red lines for building your own, and lays out supporting choices around isolation, key governance, and mobile remote takeover—which may help you avoid a few wrong turns.

en.title: MUSE Advanced Guide: From Locking Faces to Controlling Camera Moves, Building a Complete AI Video Pipeline
en.summary: If you're new to Meta's personal AI assistant Muse, you've probably only used it to chat, look things up, or generate the occasional image. But once you actually try to produce a complete short video you'd be willing to publish, you'll likely hit the usual pain points: faces swapping, distorted limbs, slow playback on longer videos, and credits draining fast. The author shares some fixes for each — worth a try.
